groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.883% and the 10Y at 5.230%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -0.67% over five sessions and +2.03% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.50% at about $103.10, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-10/100, 55% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is supportive options positioning on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.230%. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is +0.19% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -10/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: pre-market -28 → now -10; open -21 → now -10 (improved 11 points).

The main live drivers are Rates are mixed: the 10Y is 5.230%, -2.5 bp since the opening snapshot. Fed pricing is a headwind: Oct 28: Hike 71% / Hold 29% / Cut 0% · Dec 9: Above current 95% / Same 5% / Below 0% · Jan 27: Above current 98% / Same 2% / Below 0%. Weighted policy-path level score: -81/100. The weighted Fed path repricing score is -19/100 versus the prior stored session. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.883% (-0.6 bp vs prev close).
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher, semiconductor leadership rolling over, a material volatility expansion.
